name: Windrose
notes: By default friends join with the invite code that the server prints and writes to ServerDescription.json (InviteCode), with no fixed port. The port 7777 entries only matter with UseDirectConnection=true (DirectConnectionServerPort). Guides disagree on where ServerDescription.json lives (the install folder or R5\), so check yours. Each world's gameplay settings are in WorldDescription.json under R5\Saved\SaveProfiles\Default\RocksDB*\<version>\Worlds\<world id>\. Stop the server before editing either file. Not yet checked on a real install beyond the app ID (4129620, Windrose Dedicated Server; it can also be installed from the Steam client's library, under steamapps\common\): the real exe, the ports, the log file, the ready line, the stop recipe and where ServerDescription.json lives.
